name: Bone-Animated Voxel Skinning with Skeletal Mesh Voxelization
definition: A system for rendering bone-animated voxel characters by converting a SkeletalMesh to voxel data at editor time and switching between static and bone-driven voxel chunks at runtime based on asset data.
summary: Bone-Animated Voxel Skinning with Skeletal Mesh Voxelization enables real-time bone-driven voxel animation by baking bone weights and grouping voxels per bone to avoid per-vertex skinning costs.
